title: Starting gun
summary: pthread_cond_broadcast wakes every waiter; signal wakes only one.
hints: Workers: lock, `waiting++`, signal the main thread's condition, `while (!go) pthread_cond_wait(&go_cv, &m)`, `started++`, unlock.
Main: lock, `while (waiting < N) pthread_cond_wait(&all_waiting_cv, &m)`, `go = 1`, `pthread_cond_broadcast(&go_cv)`, unlock. With `signal` only ONE worker wakes and the others stay blocked forever.
